column2: Provisional, Jay to confirm. Inclusion bar and tab list are a working proposal until Jay signs off.

A hand-curated database of early and growth stage startups founded in or headquartered in Hong Kong, Stockholm, Copenhagen and Oslo. It feeds the GAIIN city pages and Signal coverage. It is a database, not a map.
Signal curates rows. Fact Check verifies each row. Head of Web builds the city pages. Comms owns intro voice. Jay's own OK is needed before any merge or publication.

One tab per city: Hong Kong, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo. The tab is the city or metro area where the startup was founded or is headquartered. An Excluded tab holds rows removed from city pages, with the reason, so they are kept but never shown.
Founded or HQ in the city or its metro area (for example Greater Copenhagen). Provisional, Jay to confirm.
Live website, or news or activity in the last 18 months.
AI, deep tech, climate or energy, fintech, robotics or physical AI, blockchain, health tech, new business models.
Its own website plus at least one independent source, such as news, a university or incubator page, or an official register.
Circle members are NOT listed in this database.
Company name as used on its own website.
Official logo URL from the company's own website or press kit only. Blank if not found. Auto-detected from the homepage and not yet confirmed by Fact Check, and display rights are not yet cleared.
GAIIN's own words, about 20 words at most, plain tone, no hype. Never copied from any database or from the company's marketing text.
Names from the company site or a primary source. Blank if not verifiable. Where a name came from a news profile or a summary of one, the notes say Fact Check should confirm it.
Publicly reported figure only. Blank if none. Never estimated. Only filled when a named source explicitly states a valuation. Funding rounds are not valuations.
URL of the source that states the valuation.
Date of that statement (YYYY-MM-DD). Some figures are old, check the date before using.
City of headquarters or main registered office. Metro area entries show the district and the metro area, for example Kastrup (Greater Copenhagen).
Markets or cities the company says it serves. High level, to be confirmed by Fact Check.
Company website.
One or more tags: AI, Deep tech, Climate / energy, Fintech, Robotics / physical AI, Blockchain, Health, New business models, Other.
Own site plus independent sources, separated by semicolons. Registers and company pages are used for verification only.
Date Signal last checked the row against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).
Pending, PASS or Fix. Signal sets Pending. Only Fact Check sets PASS or Fix.
Founded year, doubts, corrections made against aggregator data, GAIIN Signal overlap, and anything Fact Check should look at.
Rows are selected and written by hand. Never bulk-copied from Dealroom, Crunchbase or similar databases. Those may be used to find names only and are never cited.
Every row has a source and a last_verified date.
Fact Check verifies each row before it counts as verified.
A city page goes live at 15 or more verified entries (fact_check_status PASS).
Held in notes. If a year could not be verified it is left out and the notes say why.
Only explicit valuation statements from a named source. Never funding rounds, debt, financing or estimates. Aggregator pages are not used for valuations.
No em dashes or en dashes anywhere in this Sheet. Plain, no hype voice.

Seeded by hand on 2026-11-01. All rows are Pending. Rows marked DOUBTFUL in notes are weaker on city or independent source and may be dropped after Fact Check. Rows with blank founders or logo still need that field completed.

Fact Check ran on 1 Nov and set PASS or Fix on each row. Signal then applied curation decisions. Rows Signal changed were set back to Pending for Fact Check to re-check. Each change is appended to the row's notes after 'Signal 1 Nov:'.
Parahelp (HQ San Francisco) and Carbon Crusher (registered HQ Hjartdal, Telemark) were moved from the city tabs to Excluded with the reason. They are kept, not deleted, and no city page shows them.
